description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for accessing poverty line data within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints to retrieve poverty line information by PPI name and likelihood ID, with security checks and JSON serialization.

classes.name: PovertyLineApiResource
classes.description: REST resource for accessing poverty line data, including endpoints for retrieving data by PPI name and likelihood ID, secured with permission checks.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all poverty line data for a given PPI name, serializes the result to JSON, and enforces security validation.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve likelihood-specific poverty line data given a PPI name and likelihood ID, serializes to JSON, and performs security validation.
